verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents an integrations catalog that 'syncs with hundreds of the tools' and claims 100+ integrations for automated evidence collection. The evidence explicitly covers cloud services, ticketing (Jira, with follow-up tasks syncing to ticketing tools) and SSO-based app detection. However, it never names HR, code-hosting or MDM integrations, and says nothing about read-only permission scopes. Missing for 10: documented read-only scopes per integration, named HR, code-hosting and MDM connectors, explicit identity-provider integration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can connect my real stack — cloud providers, identity, HR, code hosting, MDM, ticketing — through a documented integrations catalog with read-only scopes

citations.quote: Secureframe seamlessly syncs with hundreds of the tools you're already using to automate evidence collection and continuous monitoring.
Automate manual evidence collection utilizing our 100+ integrations
Connect your cloud services to automatically check if you are configured for GDPR.
follow-up tasks are created within the same workflow and can sync to your ticketing tools
set up tasks and notifications via Jira and Slack
automatically detecting apps accessed by employees via SSO
